text: あおい　うみを　みてれば　いやな　ことも　わすれるぞ！

structure.jp: あおい　うみを　みてれば
structure.en: if you keep looking at the blue sea

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば on a verb says 'if you do this'. みてれば = 'if you are looking'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: みてれば is a short spoken form of みていれば; ている says the action keeps going. みてれば = 'if you keep looking'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push your point. わすれるぞ = 'you'll forget, I tell you!'.
